name: Zu-Den Pippi (図電ピッピ) retro-futuristic Japanese font
summary: New free Japanese display font from Moji-Waku Kenkyu, inspired by Westminster, Data 70 and the anime Zillion. One extra-bold weight in Normal and 11° Oblique, covering kana, Latin, digits, JIS level 1 (2,965) and level 2 (803) kanji plus 114 IBM extended kanji. Useful for retro/sci-fi titles, game UI and posters; free for personal and commercial use, including webfont and logos.

access.license: Moji-Waku Kenkyu font license (free font, commercial OK)
access.notes: No credit needed. Allowed: print, web, webfont, logos (incl. trademarked), video, games, apps, use in AI tools. Forbidden: redistributing/reselling or modifying the font files, AI training on the font (license updated 2026-11-13).

procedure: Click DOWNLOAD otf (zudenpippi.zip, ~3.1 MB) or DOWNLOAD ttf (zudenpippi_ttf.zip, ~4.7 MB); a WEB FONT package is also offered
Unzip and install Zu-Den-Pippi-Normal and Zu-Den-Pippi-Oblique
Read readme.txt and the license page before commercial use

verdict.why: Fresh release (11-12) by an established free-font foundry, strong traction (publisher post 421 likes/380 bookmarks, coliss 331 likes). Direct no-signup download verified, license read on publisher page: commercial use free, no credit. Caveats: no file redistribution/modification, no AI training.
